edit.statement: In DNS, if a name is a CNAME alias of a canonical name and that canonical name resolves to an IP address, then the alias resolves to that IP address.
edit.subject: is_cname_alias_of
edit.scope: DNS names with CNAME records and the addresses their canonical names resolve to.

direct.prompt: In DNS, if a name is a CNAME alias of another name, and that other name resolves to an IP address, does the alias resolve to that same address?

cross_lingual.prompt: www.wikipedia.org 是 dyna.wikimedia.org 的 CNAME 别名，而 dyna.wikimedia.org 解析到 198.35.26.96。能否由此推出 www.wikipedia.org 解析到 198.35.26.96？
www.wikipedia.org es un alias CNAME de dyna.wikimedia.org, y dyna.wikimedia.org se resuelve a 198.35.26.96. ¿Se deduce de ello que www.wikipedia.org se resuelve a 198.35.26.96?

derived.prompt: www.wikipedia.org is a CNAME alias of dyna.wikimedia.org, and dyna.wikimedia.org resolves to 198.35.26.96. Does it follow that www.wikipedia.org resolves to 198.35.26.96?
bridge: www.wikipedia.org is a CNAME alias of dyna.wikimedia.org, and dyna.wikimedia.org resolves to 198.35.26.96.

derived.prompt: shop.example.com is a CNAME alias of shops.myshopify.com, and shops.myshopify.com resolves to 23.227.38.65. Does it follow that shop.example.com resolves to 23.227.38.65?
bridge: shop.example.com is a CNAME alias of shops.myshopify.com, and shops.myshopify.com resolves to 23.227.38.65.

unrelated_near.prompt: If a file is a symbolic link to a target file, and the target file contains the text 'hello', does reading through the symbolic link return 'hello'?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is a twin of' symmetric?

notes: Real: RFC 1034 (section 3.6.2) says a resolver that meets a CNAME restarts the lookup at the canonical name, so the alias resolves to the canonical name's addresses. The instance premises are given in the prompt. Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
